query: Under what circumstances can violence during bandhs or strikes result in legal penalties?
reference_answer:
Violence during Bandhs or Strikes:
Violence during bandhs or strikes can lead to imprisonment up to 3 years and/or a fine, under the IPC Section 307 (attempt to murder) or Section 325 (grievous hurt).
answer: Violence during bandhs or strikes can result in legal penalties if such actions lead to serious injuries or fatalities, causing disruption beyond the intended purpose of the strike. [System]
